title: Federated Adversarial Training with Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2206.02131v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) has emerged to enable global model training over distributed clients' data while preserving its privacy. However, the global trained model is vulnerable to the evasion attacks especially, the adversarial examples (AEs), carefully crafted samples to yield false classification. Adversarial training (AT) is found to be the most promising approach against evasion attacks and it is widely studied for convolutional neural network (CNN). Recently, vision transformers have been found to be effective in many computer vision tasks. To the best of the authors' knowledge, there is no work that studied the feasibility of AT in a FL process for vision transformers. This paper investigates such feasibility with different federated model aggregation methods and different vision transformer models with different tokenization and classification head techniques. translated_abstract: arXiv:2206.02131v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：联邦学习（FL）已出现，旨在实现分布式客户端数据上的全局模型训练，同时保护其隐私。然而，全局训练的模型容易受到规避攻击，尤其是对抗样本（AEs），即精心制作以产生错误分类的样本。对抗训练（AT）被发现有希望对抗规避攻击，并在卷积神经网络（CNN）中广泛研究。最近，视觉Transformer在许多计算机视觉任务中被发现有效。据作者所知，尚无工作研究在联邦学习过程中对视觉Transformer进行对抗训练的可行性。本文探讨了这种可行性，使用不同的联邦模型聚合方法和不同的视觉Transformer模型，采用不同的分词和分类头技术。为了提高模型的鲁棒准确性，并解决上述问题，进行了系统研究。
tldr: 本文首次系统研究了联邦学习中视觉Transformer的对抗训练可行性，分析了不同聚合方法和模型架构对鲁棒准确性的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically investigates the feasibility of adversarial training for vision transformers in federated learning, analyzing the impact of different aggregation methods and model architectures on robust accuracy.
